notes: 0.6.48：修 issue #7 / #8（第三方 WebDAV 连不上）与 #9（反馈带不了截图）。① WebDAV 卡新增 User-Agent 输入项（#8）：部分第三方 DAV（群晖 / 坚果云 / 自建）按客户端名放行或拦截，没有这一项就只能看到「连不上」。UA 留空 = 完全不发这个头 —— 实测 Node 的 fetch 永远自带 node 这个 UA、无法表达「不发」，所以传输层从 fetch 换成 node:http / node:https，并自己处理重定向与 Content-Length；Windows 的 PowerShell 与 macOS/Linux 的 Node 引擎都走同一个 webdav.mjs，行为一致。UA 只接受单行可见 ASCII（≤ 200 字符、不含换行 / 中文 / 制表符），非法值保存时直接报错，不静默存成空。② 连不上时按状态码分开说原因（#7）：原来一律是「连不上或认证失败（PROPFIND 无响应）」，用户既不知道是密码错、还是服务不支持 PROPFIND、也不知道该改哪一项；现在 401 / 403 / 404 / 405 / 重定向 / 超时 / 证书各有一句话并指出该改哪一项，「测试连接」还会报出实际发出去的 UA，方便区分「服务端按客户端过滤」与别的原因。③ 问题反馈支持图片 / 视频 / 日志附件（#9）：走 GitHub 的 release asset 接口传成反馈仓库自己的资产，正文引用它（图片内联、视频与日志给链接），不借道第三方图床，换机器与别人看都能打开；GitHub 的 asset 接口只有 release 有（Issue 没有），所以附件挂在一个草稿 release（tag `feedback-assets`）上，不会出现在 Releases 页面；上限 4 个 / 单个 20 MB、类型白名单；不合格的附件逐条报错，没有令牌时明确告知「附件没上传、请手动拖进网页」而不是静默丢弃；建 Issue 失败时已上传的附件 URL 存进待发队列，补发时直接引用不重复上传。④ 顺带把 README 里「宿主挂 7 条路由」的陈旧数字改成实际的 13 条。验收：tools/selftest.mjs 374 条断言全绿（含 40 条新增），tools/clientcheck.mjs 全绿；另有 6 条与本次改动无关的既有失败（需要真实远端与真实客户端安装目录的用例）改动前后完全一致。
notesEn: 0.6.48: fixes issue #7 / #8 (third-party WebDAV refuses the connection) and #9 (feedback could not carry a screenshot). (1) The WebDAV card gains a User-Agent field (#8): some third-party DAV servers (Synology / Jianguoyun / self-hosted) allow or block by client name, and without this field the only thing you see is "cannot connect". Blank means **no User-Agent header is sent at all** — measured: Node's fetch always attaches its own `node` UA and cannot express "do not send", so the transport moved from fetch to node:http / node:https, now handling redirects and Content-Length itself; the Windows PowerShell path and the macOS/Linux Node engine both go through the same webdav.mjs, so behaviour matches. A UA must be a single line of visible ASCII (at most 200 characters, no newlines, CJK or tabs); an invalid value is rejected on save instead of being silently stored as empty. (2) When the connection fails, the reason is now decided by the status code (#7): it used to be one vague "cannot connect or authenticate (PROPFIND gave no answer)", so nobody could tell a wrong password from a server that does not support PROPFIND, nor which field to change. 401 / 403 / 404 / 405 / redirect / timeout / certificate each get their own sentence naming the field to fix, and "Test" also reports the User-Agent actually sent, which separates "the server filters by client" from other causes. (3) Feedback accepts image / video / log attachments (#9): they are uploaded through GitHub's release-asset interface as assets of the feedback repo and referenced from the issue body (images inline, videos and logs as links) — no third-party image host, readable from any machine and by anyone else; GitHub's asset interface exists only for releases (not issues), so the attachments hang on a draft release (tag `feedback-assets`) and never show up on the Releases page; up to 4 files of 20 MB each, restricted to a type allowlist; rejected files are reported one by one, and without a token the panel says explicitly that the attachments were not uploaded and should be dragged into the page rather than dropping them silently; when creating the issue fails, the URLs of already uploaded attachments are kept in the local queue so "Flush" references them instead of uploading twice. (4) The README's stale "7 routes" now says the actual 13. Acceptance: 374 assertions in tools/selftest.mjs pass (40 of them new), tools/clientcheck.mjs passes; the 6 remaining failures are pre-existing and unrelated to this change (they need a real remote and a real client install directory) and are identical before and after.
